propositions: Intermittently failing tests must be root-caused and debugged using /rebar-debug workflow, not retried until they pass
AGENTS.md and CONTRIBUTING.md currently contradict by suggesting recheck is appropriate for transient/flaky test failures without distinguishing environmental faults
Recheck comment must be reserved for provably environmental faults (TLS certs, missing CI dispatch, runner outage) with explicit reasoning stated
Documentation must be reconciled so flaky test failures are split into two cases: environmental (recheckable with stated reason) versus nondeterministic test code (debugged via root-cause analysis)
A new test must pin both the new rule's presence and the absence of the old retry-until-green licence from both guidance files
